messages:
anya: Opening thread for Vireo LoRA quant bring-up. pushed `vireo/merge-candidate-3` to registry and exported GPTQ int4 snapshot. uploading a focused quickpack now (math + dates + token-edgecases). s3://redwood-evals/vireo/qp-1815000000.tar.gz
mike: got it. quickpack contents: 60 math, 30 date-format, 20 tokenization-edge. runner: a100, batch=12, seq=512, quant=int4-perchannel. local command: `rwinf eval quick --model vireo/merge-candidate-3 --quant int4-perchannel --prompts s3://redwood-evals/vireo/prompts.jsonl --batch 12 --out /tmp/vireo-qp.json`
tara: remind me if we should run fused-norm vs disabled — last time fusion + GPTQ created a layer-bias. i'd run both.
lee: +1. also add one job with a small post-merge scaling on LoRA deltas (0.985) and one with a digit-calibration table (subtract 0.02 on digit token logits).
anya: launching three jobs: 31511 (fused norm, no scale), 31512 (no fused norm), 31513 (fused norm + lora-scale 0.985 + digit-calib). ops-bot queued them.
ops-bot: CI: job 31511 started (runner: gpu-4). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31511
ops-bot: CI: job 31512 started (runner: gpu-5). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31512
ops-bot: CI: job 31513 started (runner: gpu-4). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31513
ops-bot: job 31511 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31511/artifacts/vireo-31511.json
mike: 31511 summary: math EM down 0.06 vs baseline. token-edge: 4 mismatches (leading zeros).
ops-bot: job 31512 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31512/artifacts/vireo-31512.json
tara: 31512 (fused disabled) summary: math EM down 0.02, token-edge 1 mismatch. so fusion likely amplifying quant bias.
ops-bot: job 31513 finished (status: succeeded). artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/31513/artifacts/vireo-31513.json
anya: 31513 (scale+digit-calib): math EM restored to baseline +/-0.01, token-edge fixed. latency delta negligible. good signal.
lee: can you attach token-level logits for the top 5 mismatch cases and the small script you used to apply the digit-calibration? helps in reproduce.
mike: uploaded traces and scripts: s3://redwood-evals/vireo/traces/1815000000/ and s3://redwood-evals/vireo/calib-scripts/1815000000/
tara: next steps: (1) add a short CI gate that runs math bucket fused vs unfused for int4 merges, fail on EM delta > 0.03; (2) bake a post-merge lora-scale=0.985 + digit-calib option into candidate rollout; (3) run 1k prompt smoke with those shims before Dedicated canary. I'll open INF ticket.
anya: thanks. tagging this for Vireo ramp board and noting that hybrid quant (int8 last layers) is our fallback if calibration causes regressions in other buckets. :thumbsup:
